name: KAZAKHSTAN

flag.title: Sky & Sun
flag.note: Blue sky, gold sun & soaring eagle, 32 rays

lead: Kazakhstan is the world's biggest landlocked country (no sea coast). It has endless golden steppe (grassland) and Tian Shan mountain peaks. Today rockets launch from Baikonur, a space base.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Most of Kazakhstan is flat steppe. The south-east has jagged Tian Shan peaks.
The Aral Sea was once the world's fourth-largest lake. It shrank to 10% of its size when engineers diverted (re-routed) its rivers for cotton. A 2005 dam is refilling the north.
animals: The golden eagle is the national animal. Hunters called berkutchi have flown eagles from horseback for over 4,000 years.
The saiga antelope has a big, bulging nose. It filters dust and warms icy air.
culture: The host gives the sheep's head to the most honoured visitor. Beshbarmak ('five fingers') is boiled horse or lamb on noodles, eaten by hand.
The dombra is a two-stringed lute (like a small guitar). It is the soul of the steppe. People have drunk kumiss, a sour, fizzy drink made from mare's milk, for 5,000 years.
history: Silk and spice caravans (camel trains) crossed Kazakh lands. The Mongol warrior Genghis Khan swept through in 1219. The Kazakh Khanate (a kingdom ruled by a khan) rose in the 15th century.
Russia took over Kazakhstan in the 18th–19th centuries. Kazakhstan declared independence on 16 December 1991. It left the Soviet Union (a union of states led by Russia).
wows: Kazakhstan is bigger than Western Europe but has no ocean coast.
DNA studies show the wild apple forests near the city of Almaty gave us every apple.
Baikonur launched the first satellite, Sputnik (1957), and the first person in space, Yuri Gagarin (1961).
The tenge, Kazakhstan's money, got its ₸ symbol in 2007, 14 years after launch, via a national contest.
Khan Tengri, a mountain nicknamed 'King of the Sky', has a marble summit. It glows blood-red at sunset.
Saiga antelope numbers jumped from 50,000 to 2.8 million in two decades, a record recovery.
Winters in the capital, Astana, plunge to −40 °C, among the coldest for any capital.

myths.myth: Borat shows what Kazakhstan is really like
myths.fact: The comedy film Borat was filmed in Romania. Real Kazakhstan has modern cities, and women vote and drive.

myths.myth: A lake is either fresh or salty
myths.fact: Kazakhstan's Lake Balkhash is half fresh water and half salty, split by a narrow strait.
